items.title: Welcome to Habari Pulse
items.summary: Your private Kenyan news and jobs feed is ready. Run the scraper to replace these sample items with live stories.
items.text: Habari Pulse keeps full articles offline. Like or dislike stories and the ranking updates for you. The scraper runs every few hours and writes data/feed.json so the app stays fast.

items.title: How to get the APK
items.summary: Run the Build APK action, then download HabariPulse.apk from Releases.
items.text: Once the Actions workflow has run you will see real headlines. View original always links back to the publisher.
